notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
easyPrerequisites: Stiltzkin, Moogle Merchant does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Stiltzkin by paying {2} and tapping it, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a face-down creature you control, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods
